annotations.title: Create, change or delete a candidate tag

description:
[Candidates] The company's candidate tag list: action create, update (rename, recolor) or delete. Rename, recolor and delete are for owners; delete removes the tag from every candidate for good (dry_run=true shows how many carry it).

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

action.description: create: a new tag (any writer); update: rename or recolour (owners only); delete: remove the tag from every candidate and delete it (owners only, no undo).

color.description: Colour: default (the default for create), accent, success, warning or danger.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

dry_run.description: With delete: changes nothing and answers which tag would be deleted and from how many candidates. The owner-only rule is checked by the real call only.

id.description: Tag id (a tag `id` from list_candidate_filters); required for update and delete.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional company to work on. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

name.description: Tag name, 1 to 60 characters, unique in the company (case ignored); required for create.
